ai-party-without-openwallet.invalid.json.reason: an AI is identified by its openWallet ID (AN-02)

amended-first-version.invalid.json.reason: only a later version can carry the status amended

amendment-without-supersedes.invalid.jso.reason: a later version must reference the version it supersedes

author-type-ai.invalid.json.reason: an act's author type is clinician; act content from an AI is entered as a recommendation record instead (CA-02, AN-09)

derived-from-unknown-kind.invalid.json.reason: derivation sources are intake statements and clinical communications only

device-party-without-serial.invalid.json.reason: a device is identified by make, model and serial, or a resolvable device ID (AN-02, AN-13)

diagnosis-uncoded.invalid.json.reason: a diagnosis of record must be coded

draft-closed-without-recommendation.inva.reason: a draft closed because it became a recommendation names that recommendation (AN-14)

encounter-diagnosis-without-encounter.in.reason: an encounter diagnosis must reference its encounter

encounter-final-without-end.invalid.json.reason: a signed encounter has an end time

entered-in-error-without-event.invalid.j.reason: an entered-in-error act must carry the attributed entered_in_error event with a reason code

final-without-signature.invalid.json.reason: a signed status needs the author's signature

note-request-status.invalid.json.reason: a clinical note has no release lifecycle

order-unknown-category.invalid.json.reason: order category outside the closed list

party-field-of-another-kind.invalid.json.reason: a party carries only its own kind's identifying fields (AN-02)

patient-external-namespace.invalid.json.reason: the patient is always the openChart triple; an external identifier never replaces it

prescription-missing-classification.inva.reason: a prescription must carry its controlled-substance classification

prescription-transmission-state.invalid..reason: transmission and dispense states are reserved for a later governed change

recommendation-adopted-without-act.inval.reason: adoption creates a new act of the clinician's own, and the recommendation names it (AN-11)

recommendation-claim-without-claimant.in.reason: a decision a system carried for an unconfirmed decision maker names who was claimed (AN-08)

recommendation-marked-authorized.invalid.reason: a recommendation is always marked not an authorized decision (AN-09)

recommendation-unknown-missing-authority.reason: missing_authority uses the closed code list (AN-09, CD-45)

recommendation-with-act-status.invalid.j.reason: a recommendation has no act status (AN-09)

recommendation-without-missing-authority.reason: a recommendation says which authority was missing (AN-09)

record-kind-missing.invalid.json.reason: every record says whether it is an act version or a recommendation

signature-without-sign-off.invalid.json.reason: a signature carries the practitioner's openWallet and openSig sign-off evidence (CA-04, ruling 151)

writer-identity-asserted.invalid.json.reason: a writer's identity is always verified by the chart (AN-02, CD-42)
